description: Main index file for the Home module in SuiteCRM, responsible for rendering the dashboard page, managing user preferences for dashlets and pages, loading necessary resources, and displaying the dashboard interface.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine instance used for rendering the dashboard page.

methods.name: checkDashletDisplay
methods.description: Checks if a dashlet should be displayed based on user permissions and module visibility.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns the HTML output for the dashlet.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header HTML for the dashlet.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns the footer HTML for the dashlet.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns any JavaScript needed for the dashlet.

methods.name: hasScript
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the dashlet has associated scripts.
